move: card and lines fade up from blur, breathe, leave the same way
how: A single white card on a warm off-white ground containing a pill tag, a two-line headline, a paragraph and a dark button. The card fades in rising y 10 with power2.out over the first 45%; its four children follow from y 10, opacity 0 and filter blur(6px) with power2.out and a 0.11s stagger starting at 6%. At 50% the card lifts y -2 with sine.inOut as a barely visible breath. At 78% the children move up y -6 to opacity 0 with blur(4px) and a 0.04s stagger (power2.in), and the card fades out by 100% so the last frame is the empty ground.
adapt: Replace the tag, headline, paragraph and button label; change card width, radius and the background/ink colours. Keep the 10px travel, 6px blur and power2 eases; they are the quiet character of the piece.
port: mount(el, shot) renders the .card with .el children from shot.tag/title/body/cta; animate(el, shot, D) returns a gsap.timeline with the same five tweens at 0, 0.06D, 0.5D, 0.78D and 0.85D, durations scaled by D/2, selectors scoped to el.
caveats: filter: blur on text costs a little per frame but the elements are small
from() tweens need immediateRender:false if the timeline is built lazily
